remarks: Enjoy sweeping city views and stunning sunsets from this spacious high-rise condo in the heart of Stamford! This 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit features an open floor plan. The modern kitchen with breakfast bar leads into the bright and spacious living room. Relax outside on the private balcony while taking in the view. Located in a secure, gated building with 24-hour security, two elevators, and assigned parking. The condo fee includes heat, hot water, gas cooking, sewer, snow removal, cable, on-site property management, access to the fitness room, and a pool-offering unbeatable value. Prime location close to vibrant bars, restaurants, and Tully Health Center. A perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and amenities!
